about_the_game:
The Complete Sound Collection of Two NieR Titles!

The action RPGs NieR Gestalt and NieR Replicant, released for Xbox 360 and PlayStation®3, captivated players with their unforgettable music.

This album features the complete in-game BGM from both NieR titles. As a special bonus, it also includes "Shadowlord - White-note remix", an unused track from the game.

Experience the definitive edition of the NieR soundscape!
